suppliers.name: Johnson Oils
suppliers.notes: Fuelsoft WebOrdering form (scraped via browser connector). Its website *is* its quote page here, unlike most: checked 2026-09-18, a plain fetch returns one form (`mainForm`) posting to OnlineQuote.aspx with seven selects and 141 mentions of postcode, so a human fills it in rather than reading a marketing page. That is what earns the order_page, and with it `order_channel: web`.

suppliers.name: Gleaner Oils
suppliers.notes: The quote page is the wpforms form (id 1933), whose first field is a Receive a Quote / Place an Order choice; the winter-heating-oil page embeds the same form, so both take the same field numbers. Checked 2026-09-18: the page holds no price, so quote_by_request. Also phone 01224 877575.

suppliers.name: Fueltool
suppliers.notes: UK-average benchmark (scraped via HTTP). Not a local supplier. `kind` marks it as a figure rather than a company, so every row carries `kind: benchmark` and `order_channel: benchmark` and a consumer can refuse to present it as the winner without reading this sentence.

suppliers.name: Turriff Fuels
suppliers.notes: Website checked 2026-09-22: no quote form and no published price, so there is nothing to scrape. The contact page carries rory@turriff-fuels.co.uk, so this supplier is asked by email rather than by hand; 01888 562706 is the number on the site. That mail domain keeps a hyphen the website dropped, hence the matching entry in SUPPLIER_DOMAINS.

suppliers.name: Compass Fuels
suppliers.notes: Aberdeen depot (covers AB21). The homepage carries the 'Get Fuel Price' form (WordPress action compass_sector_lead), the same one on /aberdeen-fuel/; checked 2026-09-18. It asks for name, phone, email, postcode and litres and replies, so there is no price to read - hence quote_by_request rather than no_quote_page. Also phone 0330 128 9838.

suppliers.name: Carnegie Fuels
suppliers.notes: East Scotland (Dunfermline to Fraserburgh). Checked 2026-09-18: that page carries no form and no price, so there is no order_page to record and no_quote_page is the honest reason - phone 01356 648 648 or info@carnegiefuels.co.uk.

suppliers.notes: UK-wide. The homepage quote form (quote[fullname] etc., the same fields on /products/kerosene/) posts to eforms.crownoil.co.uk behind Cloudflare Turnstile and replies by email; checked 2026-09-18. No price to read, so quote_by_request. Also phone 0330 123 1444.

suppliers.name: Oilfast Insch
suppliers.notes: The Insch depot. The depot page is the quote page: two Gravity Forms (ids 10 and 2) behind reCAPTCHA, checked 2026-09-18, driven by oilwatch.form_submit; no published price, so quote_by_request. Depot line 01464 635999, general 03302 320 104.

suppliers.name: BoilerJuice
suppliers.notes: Broker/aggregator, deliberately not discovered (excluded_domains above lists boilerjuice.com). Quotes by email. Its browser connector signs in with the stored account and drives the journey's own form - postcode, volume, email, and the two required selects it used to leave on their placeholders; checked 2026-09-22, the browser refuses a submit while those are unanswered, so the page sat there unchanged and the run read as no_price_found. The quote then comes from the page's per-litre figure: the inclusive 'You Pay' option totals this note used to describe are no longer matched, and the service charge lives in those, so treat the number as the cheaper basis to compare on until they are read again. It earns its order_page the same way Johnson Oils does: checked 2026-09-18, the homepage's own buyNowQuoteForm posts to /uk/journeys/core/quote and says 'Get a quote', so there is a form on it rather than only a brochure.

suppliers.name: Brogan Fuels
suppliers.notes: RETIRED 2026-09-18: Brogan Fuels is part of Scottish Fuels, so it is not a supplier in its own right and no longer appears in any list, quote run or report. Kept as an inactive tombstone for two reasons: `init()` upserts on website, so simply dropping the entry would leave the live row active rather than retired, and the entry is where the retirement is recorded. brogans.co.uk is also in excluded_domains above, so discovery cannot re-add it.
